senses.gloss: to cast bubbles, to form protuberances, to bulge.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:4">Mikv. X, 4</cite> <he>עד שיְבַעְבְּעוּ</he> until they (the garments dipped in water) form bulges; v. <cite ref="B01022">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 157">Yalk. Sam. 157</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 3</cite> (read:) <he>שהיה שמן המשחה מְבַעְבֵּעַ ויורד עליו</he> the oil of anointment came bubbling down upon him.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 13:6:2">Y. Sabb. XIII, 14ᵇ</cite> top.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4:8">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ</cite> top. <he>תינוק מב׳ וכ׳</he> a child struggling in the river.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:8:9">Y. Yoma III, 41ᵃ</cite> <he>התחיל מב׳ וכ׳</he> commenced casting up bubbles from under the ship (Bab.
